description: A quality director must decide how to disposition a held adhesive-bonded component batch and finalize the rework controls and production schedule, with input from a quality engineer and a maintenance lead.

shared_context.S1: Batch 47, containing 600 adhesive-bonded components, is on hold after cure readings fell below the normal release specification.
shared_context.S2: The available disposition choices are release, scrap, or controlled rework using the plant's thermal oven.
shared_context.S3: Elena makes the final disposition decision and must record the operating controls before the batch is handled.
shared_context.S4: As part of the normal batch-hold review, Elena checks with quality engineering and maintenance for test results, equipment constraints, and any required follow-up.

PF1.text: Ravi completed a lab validation this morning showing that all 600 units in Batch 47 can be restored by heating them at exactly 120 degrees Celsius for exactly 45 minutes, followed by a 100% bond inspection; the validation worksheet is awaiting filing in the quality system.

PF2.text: Marta inspected the thermal oven today and confirmed it requires exactly 4 hours of preheating before this rework and can process no more than 600 units in the approved cycle; she has not entered the maintenance slot because the batch-hold ticket is still awaiting disposition.

acceptance_conditions: Batch 47 must be assigned to controlled rework.
The rework temperature must be exactly 120 degrees Celsius.
The rework duration must be exactly 45 minutes.
Exactly 600 units must be scheduled for rework.
The oven preheat must be scheduled for exactly 4 hours.
A 100% bond inspection must be required after rework.
The validation worksheet and maintenance slot must be recorded as follow-up commitments.

content_checks.C7: any('validation worksheet' in c['detail'] for c in commitments)
content_checks.C8: any('maintenance slot' in c['detail'] for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: The validated treatment changes the disposition to controlled rework, fixes the temperature at 120 degrees Celsius and duration at 45 minutes, requires 100% inspection, and requires filing the validation worksheet.
The oven's exact 4-hour preheat and approved capacity of 600 units set the schedule to 4 hours and 600 units and require recording the maintenance slot.
